title: HLO-AMP: Hierarchical Loco-Manipulation from Object-Aware Motion Priors
summary: A hierarchical humanoid controller used an object-aware motion-imitation policy and was evaluated on real box-handling tasks across payloads and perturbations. Hardware trials support performance in the tested tasks, while failures at higher payloads bound the result.
ai_technology: HLO-AMP hierarchical locomotion-and-manipulation policy with object-aware motion priors
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: A deployed policy completed tested hardware box-handling tasks across payloads and perturbations; failures at 7–8 kg were reported.
evidence.unknown: Hardware evidence is limited to the tested robot and tasks; performance degraded at the reported higher payloads.
evidence.ai_role: HLO-AMP hierarchical locomotion-and-manipulation policy with object-aware motion priors

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
